# Ilona Ayelén Pajor

> Personal website of Ilona Ayelén Pajor, political scientist from Argentina, specialist in public policies and gender justice and in university teaching. Adjunct professor at UCES, where she teaches political economy and economics and creative industries, and researcher at UNTREF (FemTech; technology, gender and cognitive capitalism) and UNNE.

- [CV en español (Markdown)](https://ilonapajor.github.io/cv-es.md): trayectoria completa en español
- [CV in English (Markdown)](https://ilonapajor.github.io/cv-en.md): full academic and professional record in English
- [CV (web)](https://ilonapajor.github.io/cv.html): same content as a web page, in both languages
